cross-server.description: 20 subjects on 20 fixture servers; every second subject requests follow-up SSH evidence (two-stage).

same-server.description: 20 distinct subjects on one fixture server using its supported investigation slots; every second subject is two-stage.

limits: Loopback provider, synthetic SSH evidence and synthetic persistence delays on a disposable SQLite database under shared local load. These records establish capability equivalence and fixture-relative throughput only; they are not a production, TLS, live-provider or MySQL benchmark, and they do not record the AI control mode. Cost is unavailable (synthetic usage), never zero.
